text:
maya: CI red on main — failing decrypt step in gha setup. looks like KMS permission denied. build: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/actions/runs/1234567890

sam: yep saw it. error log: 
```
Error: KMS decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Caller does not have kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
    at Object.decrypt (/actions/setup-secrets/index.js:42:15)
```

maya: tests blocked on that job, want a rerun or do we need a perm fix?

ci-bot: Build #4123 failed during step `decrypt-secrets` (exit code 1). Rerun available: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/actions/runs/1234567890/re-run

eng-oncall: @devops can you check the KMS key policy? my guess: CI role got rotated and lost kms:Decrypt.

devops: on it. quick check — the assume-role mapping for gha-runner-sa was changed in last rotation yesterday evening. probable cause. i can add the kms:Decrypt principal back but need approval for one-time change in infra-iam channel.

pranav: quick workaround: if someone needs a green main to unblock, you can trigger a manual rerun using a runner with legacy creds: `GHA_USE_LEGACY_CREDS=true ./scripts/gha_rerun.sh 4123` (only for urgent). Not ideal.

maya: ok please avoid legacy if possible. i just need the tests to finish so we can merge the release branch. can you do a targeted perm add and then i'll rerun?

devops: added kms:Decrypt for `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/gha-runner` to the key policy; will wait 2 mins for IAM to propagate then trigger a rerun.

sam: small ask — can we also re-run with `--no-cache` to skip a flaky cache step? sometimes false positives crop up.

devops: rerun kicked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/actions/runs/1234567900 — using patched key policy. included `NO_CACHE=1` in env.

ci-bot: Rerun started. Will post status.

maya: thanks y'all. if this keeps happening we should add a synthetic check that verifies KMS decrypt on deploy role during infra CI preflight.

eng-oncall: agreed — filed a quick ticket: INFRA-732 to add preflight and a weekly binding audit. cc @security. :spiral_notepad: 

sam: marking for a bisect if flakes persist — assigning to @pranav to coordinate.

pranav: happy to bisect if needed. will wait for rerun results and follow up.
